mapper.select: SELECT code FROM model_dispatch WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND (state IN ('BOUND_EXCEEDED','USAGE_UNKNOWN') OR (state='FAILED' AND currency IS NOT NULL)) ORDER BY started_at,id LIMIT 1
SELECT code FROM model_dispatch WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{dispatchId}
mapper.update: UPDATE model_dispatch SET code=#{code} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{dispatchId}
UPDATE model_dispatch SET state='FAILED',code='MODEL_RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{dispatchId}
mapper.select: SELECT state,code FROM model_dispatch WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{dispatchId}
mapper.update: UPDATE model_dispatch SET state='FAILED',code=#{code},ended_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{dispatchId} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND state IN ('DISPATCHED','RESPONDED')
mapper.select: SELECT t.evaluation_phase,t.evaluation_sample,t.evaluation_model,COUNT(*) AS calls,COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(d.actual_cost,d.reserved_cost)),0) AS cost FROM model_dispatch d JOIN task t ON t.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND t.id=d.task_id WHERE t.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND t.evaluation_run_id=#{runId} GROUP BY t.evaluation_phase,t.evaluation_sample,t.evaluation_model
SELECT d.id FROM model_dispatch d JOIN task t ON t.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND t.id=d.task_id WHERE t.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND t.evaluation_run_id=#{runId} AND d.state='DISPATCHED' LIMIT 1

SELECT tenant_id,id,task_id,step_id,config_digest,request_digest,state,code,started_at,ended_at,input_tokens,output_tokens,total_tokens,usage_snapshot,price_version,currency,reserved_cost,actual_cost,cost_quality FROM model_dispatch WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{dispatchId} AND task_id=#{taskId}
SELECT usage_snapshot FROM model_dispatch WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{dispatchId}
SELECT reserved_cost FROM model_dispatch WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{dispatchId}
mapper.update: UPDATE model_dispatch SET state=#{state},code=#{code},ended_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),input_tokens=#{input},output_tokens=#{output},total_tokens=#{total},usage_snapshot=#{usage},actual_cost=#{actual},cost_quality=#{quality} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{dispatchId}
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,id,task_id,step_id,config_digest,request_digest,state,code,started_at,ended_at,input_tokens,output_tokens,total_tokens,usage_snapshot,price_version,currency,reserved_cost,actual_cost,cost_quality FROM model_dispatch WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{task} AND id=#{dispatch}
